crossRefs.note: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king…
Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice…
You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest…
Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and…
The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even…
Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes; joy and gladness from the house of our God?
The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of…
The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no…
For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels, shall be…
Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither…
Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it is cut off from…
The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even…
Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you…
Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat…

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.
translations.bsb: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard and from the fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy; their shouts are not for joy.
translations.kjv: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
translations.asv: And gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.
